description:
Company Overview

The Longevity Store is a leading innovator in the health and wellness industry, dedicated to delivering science-backed solutions for longevity and optimal health. Founded with a mission to make cutting-edge health advancements accessible to all, the company has established itself as a trusted provider of premium health products. By combining rigorous scientific research, uncompromising quality, and a forward-thinking vision, The Longevity Store empowers individuals to take proactive steps toward healthier, longer lives. Link: www.thelongevitystore.com

Founders & Executive Leadership

The Longevity Store is co-founded and led by Tom van der Kolk and Bas Duijnstee. Two visionaries with a shared passion for advancing health and wellness through science. Together, they bring a dynamic and complementary leadership style to the company, driving innovation and growth while maintaining a steadfast commitment to quality and integrity. The Longevity store has a scientific advisory board, headed by Dr. Robert Lufkin, Medical Professor at UCLA and USC and Renowned expert in health optimization and longevity science.

Hero Product: The Longevity Complete

14 clinically-studied ingredients to target the hallmarks of aging. Each ingredient is carefully selected and optimally dosed to enhance cellular health, energy, and overall well-being.

  1. Astaxanthin
  2. Calcium AKG
  3. Coenzyme Q10
  4. Creatine Monohydrate
  5. Glucosamine Sulphate
  6. Green Tea Extract (45-50% EGCG)
  7. L-Glycine
  8. Lion's Mane
  9. Magnesium Taurate
  10. Magnesium Malate
  11. Quercetin Phytosome
  12. TMG (Betaine)
  13. Nicotinamide Riboside (NR)
  14. Hyaluronic Acid

Allowed health (not medical!) claims:

  1. Creatine enhances physical performance during short-term, high-intensity exercise.
  2. Nicotinamide Riboside (Vitamin B3) and Magnesium contribute to normal energy-yielding metabolism and help reduce tiredness and fatigue.
  3. Calcium and Magnesium support normal muscle function and proper muscle contraction.
  4. Creatine enhances the effects of resistance training on muscle strength in adults over 55 years (with a daily intake of 3g creatine).
  5. Nicotinamide Riboside (Vitamin B3) and Magnesium contribute to normal psychological function and the proper functioning of the nervous system.
  6. Magnesium supports cognitive processing and mental clarity.
  7. Calcium and Magnesium play a role in cell division and specialization, supporting cellular repair processes.
  8. Nicotinamide Riboside (Vitamin B3) contributes to normal cellular energy production.
  9. Calcium and Magnesium contribute to the maintenance of normal bones and teeth, supporting long-term skeletal health.
  10. TMG (Betaine) supports normal homocysteine metabolism (with a daily intake of 1.5g betaine).
  11. Nicotinamide Riboside (Vitamin B3) and Magnesium contribute to normal macronutrient metabolism.
  12. Calcium supports normal neurotransmission, while Magnesium contributes to the proper functioning of the nervous system.

Other features:

  1. Subscription Savings: Save with a subscription plan (EUR69/month vs. EUR79/month for a one-time purchase).
  2. Flexible Subscription: Modify or cancel the subscription easily at any time.
  3. 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee: Risk-free trial with a full refund if not satisfied within 30 days.
  4. Free Shipping: Complimentary shipping included with all subscription orders.
  5. Convenient Delivery: Monthly delivery ensures customers never run out of their supplement.
  6. Complimentary Vitamin D3/K2: Receive a free year-supply of Vitamin D3/K2 with a subscription.
  7. Premium Tools Included: Aluminum measurement scoop (15ML) for precise dosing & Longevity Shaker with an aluminum cap for easy mixing and portability.

Other notabilities:

  1. Premium Manufacturing Standards: Manufactured in the Netherlands in IFS-certified facilities.
    1. Non-GMO and gluten-free formulation.
    2. Third-party tested by Eurofins for quality and safety.
  2. Transparent Ingredient Listing: Full disclosure of all ingredients and dosages.
  3. Clear Allergen Labeling: Includes proper allergen warnings (may contain crustaceans).
  4. Comprehensive Customer Support: Assistance available throughout the customer journey.
  5. Educational Resources: Access to product updates, ingredient information, and longevity-focused content.
  6. Transparent Communication: Regular updates and clear policies for customer peace of mind.
  7. Easy Daily Use: Single daily scoop mixed with water for a simple and convenient routine.
  8. Pleasant Flavor: Citrus flavor designed for enjoyable consumption.
  9. Sustainable Packaging: Eco-friendly packaging materials to align with customer values.

Commission Structure

  1. 25% commission on the first order to incentivize new customer acquisition.

Promotional Guidelines & Content Requirements:

  1. All claims must comply with FDA/FTC guidelines.
  2. Avoid medical claims or treatment promises.
  3. Clearly disclose affiliate relationships.
  4. No bidding on branded terms without prior authorization.
  5. No spam, misleading advertising, or unauthorized coupon code distribution.
  6. Avoid false scarcity tactics.
  7. Personal websites and blogs.
  8. Social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube).
  9. Email marketing campaigns.
  10. Content creation and review sites.
